### Necessary instructions
- Here we take **MX-TSH51-SX** as an example

** Actual picture**:
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=c4a8243fdfaf8ada60d9285eb7465e6d)

### Operation steps
#### 1. Wiring
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=8a313b2e94cec87069943e4a1722ccb6)

#### 2. Device menu configuration
Remotely enter the menu>>Settings>>Alarm >>Input, configure ADC1 function: Positive, ADC2 function: pulse, confirm and save.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=fdd222e4e8705153f04346e95be83cdc)

#### 3. Test
The vehicle starts the rolling detection tank or simulates the can, and the alarm platform bubble box will display the real-time status (as shown below), and the historical data can be viewed in the forward and reverse report.
